citation: Efficacy and safety of daratumumab in the treatment of relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (2023); Medicine; DOI 10.1097/MD.0000000000035319; PMID 37747011
scope_note: RCTs in adults with confirmed RRMM comparing daratumumab-containing with non-daratumumab-containing regimens; reporting ORR, CR rate, PFS, or MRD negativity rate. Human studies published in English; pediatric patients and other malignancies excluded.
